items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My best musical buddy on the bandstand was Barry Rogers. ... Yes, and doing the arrangements with Barry Rogers.

ctx.x: In late ‘61. That she saved from the shopping that my father-in-law would give her to go shopping. She saved... She had a thousand dollars, and loaned me the thousand dollars, and I gave it to my friend Angelo Rosado, who owned the Triton Social Club on Bruckner Boulevard. There was dances there. No liquor. It was a social club. That’s where I met Barry Rogers earlier.
